name: Vampodyssey
description: Walk the horse up along one of two painted tracks with the point level and the pace even.

name: Pealvamp
description: Sight the mark with both eyes open along the shaft and note which track the foe watches.

name: Vampdecree
description: Jab the point at the foe from the track his shield does not cover.

name: Prism Tilt
description: Send qi down the shaft on one track and thrust on the other so the guard answers the wrong one.

name: Parity Couchrest
description: Spread the shaft and rein arms like wings to fend off a cut from either side.

name: Deluge Impact
description: Snap the rein to swap tracks on the final stride before the foe can set his guard.

name: Famed Bowl
description: Bring both tracks to one point and press the lance through the foe's guard as they meet.

name: Counterbalance Covenant
description: Fan the field of qi across both tracks to cover the rider on whichever lane he rides.

name: Gallant Lanceguard
description: Cast qi along both tracks so they close on a single point at the instant of impact.

name: Inferno Lancehead
description: Join both tracks in one cast so the lance strikes down the open line and binds the foe's guard.

name: Magnanimous Graper
description: Settle the lance in the rest on level basin floor, letting the ground teach the grip.

name: Hospitable Coronel
description: Sight a line from the rim down to the floor and judge how the slope will bend the charge.

name: Fearless Momentum
description: Run the point low across the basin floor and strike a foot soldier at the knee.

name: Pulsarvamp
description: Thrust with a pulse of qi timed to the horse's push off the basin's soft floor.

name: Steelvamp
description: Raise the shaft toward the rim and shield the rider from blows hurled from above.

name: Deluge Shatter
description: Wheel the horse along the curve of the basin so its lean follows the slope.

name: Authoritative Arrestrest
description: Heave a foe's mount into the soft mire at the basin's edge with the flat of the shaft.

name: Impacttriumph
description: Charge down the basin slope with the lance couched and let the gathered speed finish in one strike.

name: Bowltroth
description: Ride the rim and close it with qi along the shaft so no rider climbs out.

name: Pulsar Vamplate
description: Cast the whole slope's momentum through the lance and let it fall on the mark.

name: Gallant Impact Verdict
description: Strike as the slope pulls the charge forward and turn the foe's answering blow back along the rim.

name: Deluge Bellrest
description: Canter two horses side by side across the plain with the strides matched to the beat.

name: Grapergift
description: Drop both lances into their rests on the same count so the pair levels together.

name: Impactdecree
description: Jab out to the plain side of the pair at a foe who tries to slip between the horses.

name: Pealgraper
description: Glance at the gap between the horses and widen or close it by a hand's breadth.

name: Vampbanner
description: Thrust at the same instant as the partner so the foe's guard is cut in two.

name: Unwavering Counterbalance
description: Fan the qi from both shafts across the front of the pair to turn aside a sweeping cut.

name: Venomsaddle
description: Hook a foe's lance on the partner's side and pull it free of its rest.

name: Grapervoyage
description: Wheel the pair on the wide plain with the outer horse stretching and the inner shortening.

name: Quenched Ride
description: Drive the pair forward as one spearhead with the lances together at the front.

name: Steel Arrestrest
description: Halt side by side and raise a shared field of qi that checks any rush at the pair.

name: Prismbowl
description: Cast both riders' qi forward and overrun a rank with the two lances leading.

name: Exalted Quenched Vamplate
description: Strike with one lance while the other's field covers both riders, then swap roles on the next pass.

name: Deluge Momentum
description: Approach at a pace that keeps both of two lines open until the last stride.

name: Benevolent Lanceshaft
description: Aim at the place where the two lines of attack will meet and hold the point there.

name: Squall Coronel
description: Strike with the shaft's side along one fork of the approach while the point follows the other.

name: Steel Bellrest
description: Join the thrust's two strokes in one flowing line so the second rides the first.

name: Peal Lanceshaft
description: Hold the shaft steady as a stone in a stream and let the blow split round it.

name: Bedrock Tilt
description: Choose a branch at the last moment and turn the horse onto it with a short rein pull.

name: Bowldecree
description: Charge so both approaches meet at the target and the lance lands with their joined weight.

name: Parity Lancehead
description: Catch the foe's thrust at the bend of the shaft and sweep it back across his own line.

name: Graper Crown
description: Cast two streams of qi down the shaft and let them meet at the point's tip in one blow.

name: Vaunted Vacuum Shatter
description: Send two lines of attack to one meeting point so the guard breaks where they cross.

name: Couchrest Mercy
description: Sight the foe's two banner lines from a height and mark where the ranks thin between them.

name: Arrestrest Benison
description: Rise in the stirrups to a high perch with the lance raised, holding it for the beat before the stoop.

name: Gallant Bowl
description: Strike down the line between two banners where the foe's guard is thinnest.

name: Intrepid Bellrest
description: Drop the point from the high perch with qi behind it and pierce a rider beneath his banner.

name: Deluge Lanceguard
description: Turn the shaft like a pinion feather to throw a blow off the rider's high guard.

name: Duneimpact
description: Weave the horse between two banner lines in an S-curve without lowering the lance.

name: Saddlemercy
description: Lift the reins on a pulse of qi so the horse's forehand rises and the lance lifts with it.

name: Haemal Counterbalance
description: Cast the weight of the stoop down the lance and charge as the hawk falls on its mark.

name: Shackling Ride
description: Pin a foe beneath his own banner with a net of qi laid down the shaft.

name: Skyborne Momentum
description: Cast the lance through the gap between two banner lines in a flash and strike the center.

name: Steel Couchrest
description: Fall from the high perch in one cast so the strike lands and the foe's rank is pressed flat.

name: Volition Graper
description: Draw one deep breath into the Core and let it spread out along the lance.

name: Solargraper
description: Hold the lance by the Core's steadiness so the arm bears none of its weight.

name: Reminiscence Lanceguard
description: Sight the whole basin rim at once through the Core's wide awareness before the charge.

name: Quenched Lanceshaft
description: Jab the point along a line drawn from the Core to the mark.

name: Radiance Tilt
description: Feed a thread of Core qi into the point so the thrust pierces armor and the padding behind it.

name: Domed Vamplate
description: Throw a dome of Core qi from the shaft to cover the rider against blows from above.

name: Evanescent Lancehead
description: Pulse the Core through the reins so the horse changes direction before the rein moves.

name: Subjugating Ride
description: Press the foe toward the rim with a wave of qi from the shaft so his footing fails.

name: Haemalbowl
description: Charge down the basin with the Core's qi in the lance and strike with its whole weight.

name: Steelgraper
description: Anchor the Core at the basin's mouth and seal it against riders with the planted lance.

name: Vigorsaddle
description: Cast the Core's full qi up and bring the lance down upon the mark from the sky.

name: Matchless Vacuum Lanceshaft
description: Strike through the foe's guard and raise a dome of Core qi over the rider in the same cast.

name: Paritygraper
description: Speak the wind-oath under the breath as the lance drops into its rest.

name: Squall Ride
description: Hold the horse at the plateau pace that the thin air allows for a full run.

name: Quenched Shatter
description: Jab straight along the line the wind has been sworn to without a wobble.

name: Quenched Coronel
description: Drive the point through a guard with qi added at the sworn instant.

name: Deluge Lancehead
description: Turn the shaft into the plateau wind so that wind and wood together shove a blade off.

name: Spectral Impact
description: Wheel the horse in a gale without breaking the oath's bearing or the lance's line.

name: Interstice Bellrest
description: Correct the point's line at once by the flutter of the cord below the iron.

name: Quenched Momentum
description: Charge across the plateau with the wind-oath behind the lance and the gale at the back.

name: Peremptory Arrestrest
description: Hold a line across the plateau with a bar of wind drawn along the planted shaft.

name: Shatter Triumph
description: Cast the sworn wind into the iron point and drive it through guard and plate alike.

name: Bedrock Bowl
description: Strike on the sworn line and let the gale behind the lance unbalance the foe's answer.

name: Revelation Vamplate
description: Take a bearing from the saddle by a far mark and sit the horse to hold it.

name: Impact Voyage
description: Run the horse down the chosen bearing without a swerve or a check.

name: Squall Tilt
description: Jab the point along the held bearing at the foe who stands upon it.

name: Thunderclap Counterbalance
description: Feed qi into a thrust along the held bearing so the point goes through unwavering.

name: Inviolate Coronel
description: Cross the shaft over the bearing line to turn off a thrust that comes across it.

name: Spectral Bowl
description: Wheel the horse onto a new bearing in one step and keep the lance on its mark.

name: Bedrock Coronel
description: Charge along the oath's bearing and let the lance land on it with its whole weight.

name: Sigilimpact
description: Pin a rider to his own line by laying the shaft across it and binding it with qi.

name: Thunderclap Graper
description: Cast the oath-bearing down the shaft and hold it unchanged until the instant of impact.

name: Couchrest Edict
description: Strike along the bearing and bind the foe to it so his guard cannot leave the line.

name: Lanceguard Blessing
description: Perform the seat rite with knees, heels and breath set to the gale's pull.

name: Bowl Grace
description: Set the pace of the charge by rite so it neither quickens nor flags before contact.

name: Steelsaddle
description: Strike at the marked place with the shaft at its full reach, as the rite sets down.

name: Vampmercy
description: Fix the eye on the gale's edge where it meets still air and ride along the seam.

name: Tilttriumph
description: Drive the rite's rhythm through the thrust so qi lands on the strike beat.

name: Statute Arrestrest
description: Spin the shaft to raise a veil of gale across the rider's body.

name: Momentum Voyage
description: Pull the rein to keep the horse on the rite's line when the gale pushes it.

name: Entropy Impact
description: Hook a rider's arm with the shaft and drag him into the gale's pull.

name: Vigorvamp
description: Ride the whole rite as one charge and strike so the foe's line breaks in the wind.

name: Volition Lanceguard
description: Hold a rank in place against the gale with joined qi laid across the planted shafts.

name: Valiant Ride
description: Cast the rite's last gale through the lance and finish the charge on a single mark.

name: Fearless Tilt
description: Strike in rite and let the gale turn the foe's counter aside as the charge passes.

name: Vigor Vamplate
description: Sit the horse at the edge with weight low and the lance held clear of the drop.

name: Eclipse Bellrest
description: Sight along the plateau's lip to find the firm stretch and the crumbling one.

name: Magnificent Graper
description: Jab outward from the edge side at a rider whose horse stands near the drop.

name: Pulsar Counterbalance
description: Press the thrust with qi so the foe is driven back toward the lip.

name: Delugegraper
description: Turn the shaft away from the drop to deflect a blow without losing footing.

name: Deluge Lanceshaft
description: Skirt the plateau's lip in a tight wheel that never puts a hoof over it.

name: Impactbanner
description: Charge along the lip with the drop at one side and strike as the line closes.

name: Impactpledge
description: Lay the lance across the path along the lip and bar the way with a seal of qi.

name: Pulsarimpact
description: Cast the lance's weight at the lip and sweep the foe's mount over it with the point.

name: Vaunted Inferno Shatter
description: Strike so the foe is pressed back toward the lip and cannot find the footing to answer.

name: Gracious Lancehead
description: Sit the sworn seat deep so the long wind passes round the rider rather than through.

name: Pacing Arrestrest
description: Hold the pace of the line by watching the sworn rider ahead.

name: Reminiscence Counterbalance
description: Sight the edge of the long wind across the plain and place the charge inside it.

name: Vaunted Bowl
description: Drive qi into the point at the surge of the long wind and pierce the guard.

name: Coronel Troth
description: Spin the shaft to draw a veil of wind over the rider beside the wielder.

name: Bedrock Couchrest
description: Borrow the wind's push through the rein and quicken the horse for a stride.

name: Entropy Tilt
description: Hook a rider's saddle edge and pull him into the gale's grip.

name: Inferno Ride
description: Charge with the line sworn and the long wind filling every rider's back.

name: Lanceguard Vow
description: Hold a foe down under the line's joined qi until the sworn riders have passed.

name: Windborne Impact
description: Cast the lance down the long wind in a flash and pierce the mark before it can turn.

name: Dauntless Pulsar Lanceshaft
description: Strike through the foe's guard on the wind's surge and turn his counter aside on its ebb.

name: Vigorgraper
description: Swear the oath on a breath drawn into the Core before the lance is raised.

name: Compassionate Bellrest
description: Seat the butt in the rest with the Core holding the lance's weight and not the arm.

name: Revelation Lancehead
description: Feel the gale's direction through the Core and sight the lance along it.

name: Saddlecrown
description: Jab along the bearing the Core has set, sharp and straight to the mark.

name: Storied Vamplate
description: Thrust with the gale's push and a thread of Core qi to pierce plate.

name: Statute Counterbalance
description: Draw a veil of Core qi and wind about the shaft to blunt a thrust.

name: Pulsing Couchrest
description: Pulse the Core through the rein so the horse steps to the new line unprompted.

name: Unbending Graper
description: Shove a foe's shaft aside with a gust of Core qi and wind through the wood.

name: Squall Momentum
description: Charge in the gale with the oath sworn and the Core's qi poured into the point.

name: Unyielding Graper
description: Hold the sworn line with the Core's qi so no rider breaks through the planted lance.

name: Exalted Vamplate
description: Cast the gale and the Core together into the lance and bring it down on the mark.

name: Vacuum Impact
description: Strike through the guard and bind the foe to the sworn line with the Core's wind.
